title: LLM-AS-A-JUDGE & REWARD MODEL: WHAT THEY CAN AND CANNOT DO
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the reliability, factual verification, and complex reasoning abilities of LLMs used as judges and reward models. While it includes 'social issues' as a knowledge category in its benchmark, the core focus is on evaluation performance, language transfer, and detection of inaccuracies rather than religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral frameworks.
